newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB unit to launch unit trust.
newsitem.headline: OUB unit to launch unit trust.

text.p: OUB Asset Management Ltd, a subsidiary of Overseas Union Bank Ltd (OUB), said on Friday it would launch a unit trust in Singapore to invest in health care, leisure, entertainment and wealth management.

The company said in a statement that the Global Affluence Fund, to be launched on March 23, would invest about 50 percent in health-related companies, 25 percent in tourism, leisure and entertainment firms and the rest in wealth management services.
The fund planned to invest about 40 percent in the United States, 15 percent in Japan, 25 percent in the rest of Asia and 20 percent in Europe, the statement said.
"We expect the fund to grow at about 10 percent to 15 percent per annum in the medium term," it quoted UOB Asset Managmeent executive director Goh Mui Hong as saying.
The minimum initial subscription to the fund would be Singapore $5,000 with subsequent investments in multiples of S$1,000, the statement said.
It said the fund could be regarded as fairly defensive in nature since the health-related sectors were indispensible. The statement did not say how large it expected the fund to be.
OUB groups currently manages funds of about S$2.5 billion.
